summary: Not yet is a flat hand hanging down by the hip and swinging back and forth, with a head shake and a slightly open mouth. It answers 'did you...?' with 'not yet.'
location: At the side by the hip
steps: Drop a flat hand to your side, fingers pointing down.
Swing it back and forth a little.
Shake your head and let your tongue rest on your lower teeth, mouth slightly open. That mouth shape is part of the sign.
mistakes: Forgetting the mouth. NOT-YET and LATE share the hand movement; the head shake and mouth make it 'not yet.'
